blocks.content: We, the people of India, having solemnly resolved to constitute India into a Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic.

rows: Entire Constitution came into full effect

items: Direct question frequently asked on the duration of Constitution making: 2 years, 11 months, 18 days.
Note the difference: Constitution was ADOPTED on 26 Nov 1949, but came into FORCE on 26 Jan 1950 (Republic Day).
Drafting Committee had 7 members with Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the Chairman.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Constituent Assembly took 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days to frame the Constitution of India.
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar served as the Chairman of the Drafting Committee.
The Constitution was adopted on 26th November 1949 and came into full effect on 26th January 1950.
Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha was elected as the temporary President of the Constituent Assembly.
Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the permanent President of the Constituent Assembly.
